findings.title: Auto-Dreamer publishes multiple static ScienceWorld selection artifacts, but none can yet be equated to the paper 660-task stream from filenames alone
findings.observation: The current Hugging Face tree exposes several ScienceWorld eval-split specs and a seeded fixed-validation artifact. Their names encode recipes such as 1per/5per, 9type, K10, eval10 and 9cat/per10/evals6/seed42. These are useful static selection artifacts, but the paper's online result uses a separately described seven-task-type 660-task frozen episodes.jsonl. Without file contents and an explicit run/derivation bridge, the current split artifacts cannot be substituted for that historical evaluation manifest.
findings.scope_guard: No claim is made that the public split artifacts are unrelated; only identity/equivalence remains unproven.

findings.title: Current public OpenTinker main does not expose the Auto-Dreamer paper's named memory-training source paths
findings.observation: The paper names opentinker/memory_training/ as the source of reported prompts, but the current public OpenTinker main recursive tree at f87fe25fc483e7f1d7596182fc55115cbc992724 contains no memory_training, scienceworld or dreamer path, and targeted current-code searches return no matches. Therefore current OpenTinker main is not sufficient to reconstruct the paper's full Auto-Dreamer implementation/source revision.
findings.scope_guard: Current-main negative only. Historical branches/commits, a private paper-time tree or a separate repository may contain the missing implementation; this finding does not claim the code never existed or was not used.

full_replay.reason: Evaluation selection artifacts and current upstream source are not yet bound to the exact historical 660-task run and paper-time Auto-Dreamer implementation revision.
